user_goal.statement: Each business Agent should present one normal ChatGPT-facing product entry while GitHub remains durable engineering/rule/continuity authority. Internal executors, guards, runtime bindings and assurance labels must make that experience reliable without becoming user-selected product routes.
not_requested: deploy or require a new MCP service
remove internal execution or assurance identifiers
move all owner business state into Universal or GitHub continuity
weaken fail-closed quality or evidence gates

parent_system_outline.authority: owner GitHub main holds engineering/rule authority; exact business state/checkpoint authority remains owner-declared
parent_system_outline.dispatch: current-session capability handshake selects internal executor/evidence mode
parent_system_outline.workflow: one canonical owner business workflow/SOP/quality contract
parent_system_outline.persistence: owner-specific guarded state/checkpoint + Universal continuity/lease where applicable
parent_system_outline.bypass_surface: Skill/manifest/readiness prose that makes internal modes look like separate user routes

root_cause.detail: Universal execution-readiness correctly distinguished capability/assurance modes, and owner manifests described runtime layers, but the shared Agent architecture never encoded the product-interface boundary: one ChatGPT-facing owner entry, internal mode selection, one canonical owner workflow. Owner Skills therefore leaked implementation vocabulary into normal product use.

history.lesson: Guarded GitHub chat was intentionally made first-class for the user's GitHub-mounted + GPT-chat operating model.
Financial already converged business workflow control into one kernel while preserving adapter-specific persistence/assurance.
Universal added readiness routing, but did not declare that routes are internal product implementation.

sources.learning: Skills are workflow guidance/resources and can orchestrate available tools; they do not require separate user workflows per executor.
Plugins can package Skills and optional tools/MCP; smallest useful shape is valid.
Plugin installation/product surface is separate from the backend execution mechanism.

alternatives.failure_mode: Fresh chats and other owners can repeat the same route-leakage confusion.
Leaves the shared architecture defect active in A-share/Novel/Video and future owners.
Destroys useful readiness/assurance/evidence distinctions and weakens fail-closed execution.
If overbroad, could incorrectly force owner business state into one substrate; design therefore constrains only the user-facing entry and dispatch semantics, not domain state authority.

rules: OWNER_NATIVE, CHAT_BRIDGED, DETERMINISTIC_TOOL and ISOLATED_EXTERNAL remain internal dispatch/evidence labels.
Normal task use does not ask the user to select an execution mode.
Expose implementation/assurance mode only when the user asks, when diagnosing a blocker, or when a genuine external authorization/decision is required.
Capability differences may change assurance or block an exact hard gate; they may not define a second SOP or silently narrow the canonical business contract.
GitHub main remains engineering/rule/continuity authority; owner-specific business state/checkpoint authority remains domain-declared.

business_state_boundary: No BUSINESS task lease, business-stage state, article, market-day decision, novel Canon/project state, or video project truth may be changed by this SYSTEM_INFRA propagation.
validation_plan: Add deterministic Universal product_interface validation and focused regression.
Move all current BUSINESS manifests to architecture contract 1.2 and declare the same product interface.
Apply minimal owner Skill wording changes without changing business SOP.
Run/observe each owner CI; retain existing unrelated drift/open assurance rather than claiming it closed.
Refresh Universal architecture observation cache only after exact owner heads and validation evidence are known.
Run Universal risk-tiered audit, Agent architecture audit and full pytest.
Reopen M7 if validation or second-order review exposes a contradiction.
open_world_boundary: This repair cannot prove future model behavior, live editorial/market/novel/video quality, provider isolation, external credentials, or that every future UI/product change will preserve the interaction surface.
